game_title: Function Test Arena – Cold Larder Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Snowy Hold – Cold Larder, an ice-cellar larder: the hold guard must handle frozen golems while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing frozen golems.
theme: Snowy Hold – Cold Larder: an ice-cellar larder
core_gameplay_loop: In Cold Larder, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing frozen golems. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the hold guard ahead. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the beacon fire by solving code steps involving tests_passed that move the hold guard forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the beacon fire first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Function Test Arena' (Week 6 slot 13), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Cold Larder'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frozen golems in Cold Larder.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
